# agent_safety

> Zero-dependency Python library for least-privilege runtime control of AI
> agents: mark functions with @tool, scope what's allowed with safely(...).
> An agent can only invoke the capabilities you granted, on the budgets you
> set; nested scopes only tighten. Works with Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and MCP.

Golden path:

    from agent_safety import tool, safely

    @tool
    def read_file(path): ...

    with safely(allow="read_file", calls=10, hide_secrets=True):
        read_file("notes.txt")
